data_mode: FULLY REAL: SPP GPS positions + real IMU + real wheel odometry + cm truth

config.degraded_def: real GPS fix with <=5 satellites (poor geometry)
config.p_degraded_source: geometry proxy (satellite count); SENTINEL model used on labelled data

_methodology: FULLY REAL GNSS: positions computed by GPS-only L1 Single Point Positioning (SPP)
from the real rover_ublox.obs pseudoranges (broadcast ephemeris, sat-clock, Sagnac,
Saastamoinen tropo). Errors are REAL urban multipath/NLOS, not synthetic.
Real GNSS arrives at 5 Hz with genuine outages (epochs the receiver could not fix);
the EKF predicts at 10 Hz on real IMU + wheel-odometry and updates only on real fixes.
Degradation is defined by REAL satellite geometry (<=5 sats), not injected windows.
